ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) pixels and localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base pigmentation; left lobe features a dense spatial distribution of small, circular high-intensity rings; right lobe features larger, irregular amorphous high-intensity patches concentrated near the trailing edge and distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped vertex; approximate 45-degree interior angle; vertical depth is approximately 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; peak-to-valley variations range from 8 to 25 pixels; approximately 13 distinct peaks identified per lobe along the trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave curve emerging from the median notch, transitioning into a steep upward convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular/annular high-intensity white pixel rings (4-15 pixel diameter) primarily localized on the left lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of a single, near-vertical dark linear pixel disruption on the far-left lateral margin, approximately 80 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, three-dimensional, textured brownish-tan organic clusters (barnacle colonies) adhering to and extending from both distal tips, altering the fluke's natural silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive ring-like morphology of white scars on the left lobe showing hollow-center pixel intensity profiles.
